description: Whether reported numbers reconcile exactly to the recorded events, and whether one customer's figures can ever contain another's.

metrics.description: Reported metrics that do not equal the value derived from raw events.
metrics.measurementMethod: For each metric with a declared formula, recompute from the event table and compare against the served figure. Any difference counts.

metrics.description: Events from one workspace appearing in another workspace's figures.
metrics.measurementMethod: Seed two workspaces with distinguishable events, then assert each tenant-scoped query returns exactly its own and that the platform-wide query returns the union.

metrics.description: Events counted more than once because of a retry, refresh or replay.
metrics.measurementMethod: Submit the same event with the same idempotency key repeatedly and count how many rows are persisted beyond the first.
